risk_note: RV2 (orders/** + platform/queue/catalog.ts; order sync). Incremental sync per stream (app, platform, union account, increment, '-'): windows from the sync cursor (sync_start_at first; none when it is null), pdd 30-minute cap, enqueued on the new exclusive order-sync queue with singletonKey platform:account:kind:scene:window_start; no enqueue while the breaker is open or site authorization is unavailable; only the union account the deployment's credentials belong to is synced when SyncAccessPort.queryableAccount is provided. The window handler pages listOrders into the pipeline port, retries the whole window on any failure, and advances the cursor in one transaction only when the stored cursor equals window_start. No order rows are written yet (pipeline port is a TODO until B1-08h); worker wiring is B1-08n.
